description: A FastAPI application defining two endpoints for uploading files: one reads the file as bytes and returns its size, the other accepts an UploadFile object and returns its filename.

methods.name: create_file(file: Annotated[bytes, File(description="A file read as bytes")])
methods.description: Endpoint to receive a file as bytes and return its size.

methods.name: create_upload_file( file: Annotated[UploadFile, File(description="A file read as UploadFile")], )
methods.description: Endpoint to receive an UploadFile and return its filename.

ctags.name: create_file
ctags.pattern: /^async def create_file(file: Annotated[bytes, File(description="A file read as bytes")]):$/
ctags.signature: (file: Annotated[bytes, File(description="A file read as bytes")])

ctags.name: create_upload_file
ctags.signature: ( file: Annotated[UploadFile, File(description="A file read as UploadFile")], )
